issue: The reused Project schema marks id readOnly, so request validation rejects project.id. JetBrains explicitly requires project (id) and its create-issue example sends project.id=0-0.

The reused Issue schema marks id and idReadable readOnly, so request validation rejects the issue reference. JetBrains explicitly requires issues containing id or idReadable and its examples send idReadable.
The reused Tag schema marks id readOnly, so request validation rejects the existing tag reference. JetBrains explicitly requires id and its add-tag example sends id=146-25.
